OWNER SETUP

A few steps to connect your people.

Your project URL and publishable key are configured. Finish the steps below in your Supabase dashboard. The public key cannot change your database or authentication settings.

Connection status

Checking your Supabase project…

1. Install Google-only database permissions

If this project has no PlanFix tables yet, download the full setup SQL, paste it into a new query in Supabase’s SQL Editor, and click Run.

Download full setup SQLOpen Supabase SQL Editor ↗

If you already installed the previous PlanFix database, run only the upgrade below. It changes access permissions and preserves all existing records.

Download Google-only upgrade SQL

The full installation is for a new PlanFix database. The upgrade is safe to rerun. Neither file deletes existing plans or users.

2. Disable anonymous access

In Authentication → Sign In / Providers, keep Anonymous Sign-Ins disabled. PlanFix requires a verified, non-anonymous Google account for all plan, group, vote, and invitation operations. The SQL also blocks older anonymous sessions from reading or modifying records.

Open authentication settings ↗

3. Configure your website URL

Under Authentication → URL Configuration, set the Site URL and add this exact URL to the redirect allowlist:

https://planfix-social-plans.glitteringmotor3.chatgpt.site/Open URL configuration ↗

4. Enable Google sign-in

  1. In Google Cloud, configure an OAuth consent screen and create an OAuth client of type Web application.
  2. Set the authorized JavaScript origin to:https://planfix-social-plans.glitteringmotor3.chatgpt.site
  3. Add this authorized redirect URI to the Google OAuth client:https://efwefmhcjbatxfylmqqx.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback
  4. In Supabase’s Google provider settings, enable Google and enter the client ID and client secret there.

If the Google consent screen is in testing mode, add your Google account as a test user. Keep the Google client secret in Supabase; it is not needed in chat or website source.

Try it out

Open PlanFix and use Continue with Google. Check that your profile appears, create a plan, and refresh to verify the session persists. Sign out and confirm that the dashboard and plan actions are inaccessible. Test an invitation in another browser: Google sign-in must come first. The Sites hosting audience is still private; outside friends can use invitations after you choose to make the site public.
